messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: deploy-canary-failure fired for service=redwood-runtime-canary env=staging. AlertID=PD-98271. See runbook: https://go/runbooks/canary-fail

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired -> Escalation policy: runtime-oncall -> Primary: Sam Rivera (rotation). Incident URL: https://pd/redwood/incidents/PD-98271

Sam Rivera: ack. i'm on it. Sam (oncall) switching to this thread. any quick signal on what failed?

Maria Lopez: our deploy of v2.3.4 started at 12:47 UTC, canary traffic 5% to new kernel+quant patch. telemetry started spiking ~12:52. rolling back if needed. pinging logs.

Lee Zhang: getting 503s from embed-worker canaries in eu-west-1, qcache timeouts in logs. assigning to Sam/Lee to triage.

Sam Rivera: copying logs from canary pods:
```
2026-03-14T12:52:13Z embed-worker[pid=4231]: ERROR: kvcache lookup timeout (100ms) key=prefix_abc
2026-03-14T12:52:14Z http: response 503 service=embed-worker canary=true req_id=xyz123
2026-03-14T12:52:15Z runtime: kvcache rpc latency p95=1.6s p99=3.4s
```

Maria Lopez: that matches the Q/heuristic change we rolled in earlier. canary config toggled shared-kv to async mode.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: alert escalated to secondary -> Lee Zhang (rotation) after 5m no ack by secondary.

Lee Zhang: ack. oncall Lee here. i'll stop canary traffic and trigger abort. please confirm rollback policy.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step: "abort canary and divert traffic"
- command: `redwoodctl rollout abort --deployment embed-worker --canary --reason "kv-timeouts v2.3.4"`
- fallback: `redwoodctl rollback --to-release v2.3.3 --force`
- notify: #customer-impact thread and SRE page.

Sam Rivera: running `redwoodctl rollout abort --deployment embed-worker --canary` now.

Sam Rivera: abort returned ok. canary tasks draining, diverting traffic back to v2.3.3.

Maria Lopez: confirmed: canary instances terminating, request routing at 12:58 UTC moved back to baseline. metrics show drop in 5xx.

Lee Zhang: checking metrics: p50 unchanged, p99 back to baseline within 2 mins.

Sam Rivera: PD: acknowledging incident and marking as mitigated. Can we mark customer impact? Maria - any external customers impacted?

Maria Lopez: preliminary: ~1.8% of requests in eu-west-1 saw 503s for ~6 minutes. No enterprise customers reported errors in support console yet, but ops should run list of recent 500s to notify any affected tenants.

Lee Zhang: opened follow-up ticket: ENG-1249 to revert the async-kv change and run load test. assigning to Maria + runtime team.

Maria Lopez: will schedule rollback to main branch and hotfix release if root cause confirmed.

Sam Rivera: adding incident tags: canary-fail, deploy-triggered, pd-page, mitigated. assigning postmortem owner: Maria Lopez.

incident-bot: Incident PD-98271 mitigated -> status changed to "resolved" by oncall. Closing Slack thread. :white_check_mark:
